§6Network Switches & Cables§f

§aWire your machines together and move data across your base.§f
Computers, screens, servers, and external devices communicate through a wired or wireless network.

§6Infrastructure§f:
§bNetwork Cable§f: Physical link for power and data.
§bNetwork Card§f: Lets a computer send and receive wired messages. 16 open ports max.
§bWireless Network Card§f: Tier 1 range is 16 blocks, Tier 2 is 400 blocks. Costs 0.05 energy per block of range.
§bAccess Point§f: Bridges wired to wireless. Stores 600 energy.

§6Switch Upgrades§f:
A Switch routes packets between sub-networks. Default: 5 tick relay delay, 20 packet queue, 1 packet per cycle.
§bCPU§f: Reduces delay by 1.5 ticks per tier.
§bHDD§f: Increases queue by 10 packets per tier.
§bRAM§f: Increases packets per cycle by 1 per half-tier.

§9AE2 Gate§f:
ME 1k Storage and Fluid Storage Components both need a Tier 2 Server and a Network Card. Networking is mandatory for digital storage.
